# Motion and No-JS Resilience Requirements Quality Checklist: The portfolio

**Purpose**: Validate progressive-enhancement, scroll-effect and browser-support requirements (complements accessibility.md, which covers the reduced-motion and JavaScript-off reading checks).
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Progressive Enhancement

- [ ] CHK001 Is the baseline (no script, no scroll-linked effects, no transitions) stated as the default from which each effect is added? [Clarity, Spec §FR-063]
- [ ] CHK002 Is a supported-browser list or capability rule defined for scroll-linked effects and page transitions? [Gap, Spec §FR-063]
- [ ] CHK003 Are script-failure cases (script blocked, fails to load, throws) covered, not only script turned off? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-062]
- [ ] CHK004 Is "loaded no earlier than it is needed" quantified for the filter, comparison and demo enhancements? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-064]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for the first paint state of headings and visuals so nothing flashes hidden then shown? [Gap, Spec §FR-025]

## Scroll Effects

- [ ] CHK006 Is the reading-progress measure defined (whole page or story body, and treatment of the footer)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the sticky visual's behaviour defined for chapters with no visual, short chapters and tall visuals? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the breakpoint for "wide screens" stated, and what narrow screens get instead? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the effect of anchor links and reload-at-scroll-position on the uncover effect specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK010 Are print and text-only reader modes addressed or excluded? [Coverage, Gap]

## Transitions and Media

- [ ] CHK011 Are transition requirements defined for back/forward navigation and direct entry on a story page? [Coverage, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK012 Is behaviour defined when the filtered index is left and re-entered through the transition? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK013 Are clip requirements defined for looping, length limit and data-saving conditions? [Gap, Spec §FR-044]
- [ ] CHK014 Are performance-budget targets for effects and embeds stated with numbers, or by reference to the site's budget? [Measurability, Spec §FR-083, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the deferral of the embedded frame's load defined for readers with script off (link only, or frame)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-041, Spec §FR-061]
